ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) background with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as localized spots and rings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular and annular blobs are scattered across both lobes, with a higher concentration of dense white clusters near the distal tips and lower density near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 65 degrees with a deep, symmetric bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary exhibits irregular, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) with an increase in jaggedness and pixel-amplitude towards the lateral lobe extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curvature from the median notch extending towards the tips, while the overall lobe shape follows a convex upwards sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular high-contrast pixel clusters and white ring-like formations (rosette scars) across the entire visible ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the mid-section of the right lobe, breaking the dark pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive live barnacle colonization (acorn and gooseneck varieties) creating irregular, high-contrast structural protrusions on both distal tips, obscuring the natural edge geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique brown/dark-toned organic masses attached to the barnacle clusters at the extreme lateral edges of both lobes.
